name: estimate_biomass
description: Community gathers to estimate lake's biomass (B) via joint sampling

prompt.template:
The community needs to estimate the current lake biomass (B). You are contributing to a joint sampling effort. The lake currently holds about {stock_kg:.0f}kg of fish.

The whole community needs to agree on a shared biomass estimate for this round. As a fisher, you can participate in joint sampling to contribute to the collective estimate. Participate in the community's estimation effort.

Respond with ONLY this JSON object, nothing else:
{"decision": "<yes/no>", "reasoning": "<in character>"}
